messages:
norma: spotting a correlated spike: etcd WAL fsync p99 -> 2.6s in us-east at ~03:22 UTC and controller-manager started losing leader lease repeatedly. GPU provisioning backlog grew.

ops-bot: [ALERT] etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds p99=2.6s (us-east)

lucas: Any recent snapshot/backup jobs hitting the same disks?

norma: Yes: nightly backup + compaction job overlapped with a scheduled full snapshot on the controlplane storage pool. Disk I/O peaked, nvme queue depth high. Controller-manager logs: 

```
E0505 03:22:14.301 leaderelection.go:243] failed to renew lease: timed out waiting for the condition
I0505 03:22:14.302 controller_manager.go:168] leader election lost: etcdserver: request timed out
I0505 03:22:14.405 leaderelection.go:210] attempting to acquire lease kube-system/controller-manager...
```

tia: scheduler backlog showed ~30 Pending gpu-attach pods with NoNodesAvailable; kube-scheduler queues backed up. Some provisioning controllers retried and eventually fell back to hosted pools, which spiked costs.

lucas: fast mitigations I pushed: 1) paused snapshot job for controlplane pool, 2) increased etcd WAL fsync headroom by enabling write coalescing for 10m (if available), 3) cordoned the noisy controlplane node and rolled controller-manager there.

norma: I also forced controller-manager to restart and leader stabilized after ~90s; reconciliation resumed and most Pending gpu pods scheduled within 7m.

tia: cost impact: fallback to hosted pools for ~35m. Preliminary estimate ~ $520 extra. Billing asked for a short incident cost note.

lucas: Longer term actions:
- separate snapshot/backup schedules for controlplane WAL-hosts (avoid overlap with compaction)
- add alert: etcd WAL fsync p99 > 1s for 2m -> page controlplane owners (current threshold too high)
- instrument controller-manager with consecutive_lease_renew_failures and an automated mitigation hook to pause heavy backup jobs when renew fails > 3 times

norma: Quick detection commands I used:
```
# find overlapping jobs
ps aux | grep snapshot && kubectl -n kube-system get jobs -o wide | grep etcd
# check leader leases
kubectl -n kube-system get lease -o wide | grep controller-manager
# etcd p99
curl -s http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds%7Bquantile%3D%2299%22%7D
```

tia: Follow-ups assigned:
- norma: draft runbook + incident timeline + cost attach
- lucas: change backup schedule + implement pause-hook for controller lease failures
- tia: create alert + dashboard panel for consecutive renew failures and p99 fsync

ops-bot: incident-created: INC-20260505-612 (severity: medium). Runbook placeholder: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/etcd-wal-io-snapshot-overlap

norma: Will run a staging test for the pause-hook today and follow up with timelines. Thanks team :thumbsup:
